notes.title: Halloween Update: Steam Scream - The Revenge! ver.0.41.4992
notes.content:
Halloween Update: Steam Scream - The Revenge!
Celebrate Halloween with some spooky changes! Here's what's new:

[list]
[*][h3]Easier Quests[/h3]
We've made all the stages easier to play.

[*][b][h3]Clear Minimap in Easy Mode[/h3][/b]
On Easy mode, the minimap is now much clearer, showing all paths and crawlspaces.

[*][b][h3]Narrower Levels[/h3][/b]
The levels are now smaller and more focused.

[*][b][h3]Main Quests Only[/h3][/b]
You only need to complete the main quests to win the game.

[*][b][h3]New Striped Costume[/h3][/b]
Get into the Halloween spirit with a new striped costume!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/0baa7587c6a9e958facb85bef1172dfddcd2db93.gif[/img]

[*][b][h3]Witch Hat Accessory[/h3][/b]
Top off your costume with a cool Witch Hat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/e5120a7e8de90381dfab55b501ac28164382a0f0.gif[/img]
[/list]

Enjoy the spooky season with Steam Scream: The Revenge!

We hope you will have a joyful time, even with this small update due to our developers being occupied with other tasks:

notes.title: New Stage The Shade of Sloth now available to play!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the latest update of our game, where a new Sloth Stage has been added to Steam![/h1]

We would like to introduce a new boss, the Doll of Revenge, born from the Sin of Sloth. It invites players to play the game of death, where they have to survive the deadly challenges presented to them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/093d839b0ed50be4505f0859b7325f2a2a0e1c82.gif[/img]

The new stage is set in an interior scene, where players have to find puzzles along the walls of the room to progress. Unlike the previous stages, players need to open the door instead of crawling to the next area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/d42dcf9b2873f956525c8ee4d2f1ca7abf1672ab.png[/img]

Players need to be careful in this stage, as the Doll of Revenge has a subordinate who is undercover and waiting to strike when the players least expect it. The game is designed to make your heart stop beating with every twist and turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/46124d0b51eba12bb62d080219b3d23cc2edfbe8.gif[/img]

So, are you ready to face the challenges presented in the new Sloth Stage? Let's play and see if you can survive the game of death!

Other updates
- Background music for each stage
- New Sloth Stage Achievement
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554409/ae70ae2bfa7aeb960d869caad331dd35ccb03f45.png[/img]

notes.content:

New Feature: Easy / Normal / Hard / Hell
We've added four different difficulty modes to our game: Easy, Normal, Hard, and Hell.
Each mode comes with its own set of challenges and rewards, so you can choose the one that suits your skills and preferences best.
You can select difficulty in the lobby before start game.
Different difficulty modes will effect to Holes, Minimap, Ghost, and Items.
